entities.name: Saviors of Kamigawa
entities.description: The thirty-fifth Magic expansion, third set in the Kamigawa block, released in June 2005.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane of the Kamigawa block, torn by conflict between the spirit and human realms.

entities.name: Toshi
entities.description: A ronin who sought to avoid the great conflict between the spirit and human realms but is at the center of it.

entities.name: Princess Michiko
entities.description: Daughter of Daimyo Konda; she works with Toshi to stave off the kami's victory.

entities.name: Kami
entities.description: The spirits whose impending victory in the conflict threatens the human realm.

events.summary: Toshi, despite avoiding the conflict, becomes the center of the war between the spirit and human realms.
events.quote: But despite his best efforts, he's not only involved in it, he's at the center of it.

events.summary: Toshi and Princess Michiko must find a way to stave off the impending victory of the kami.
events.quote: he must find a way to stave off the impending victory of the kami
